title: video-to-latex spawn-capture-segments output
description: The gc.output_json emitted by the spawn-capture-segments step of video-to-latex. The on_complete fan-out iterates over output.segments, bonding one video-to-latex-capture-segment formula per element. key_frames is a comma-separated string (not an array) so it maps directly to the child formula's key_frames var.

segments.description: Ordered list of video segments, one per fan-out bond. Derived from {{paper_dir}}/segments.json produced by calibrate_segments.py.

t_start.description: Segment start time in seconds (absolute offset into the video/audio).

key_frames.description: Comma-separated absolute paths to this segment's key frame PNGs. Primary keyframe first, then supplementary pre-erase frames and uniform-sample frames in time order. Maps directly to the key_frames var of video-to-latex-capture-segment.
